release_notes:
v1.0.8+8 - Dedicated Two-Panel Split: Registered Student Store vs Guest Hub & Public Catalog
- Established Two Authoritative Feeding Panels: Registered Student Store & Portal Materials (feeding enrolled student uniforms, merch & curriculum) and Guest Hub & Public Catalog (feeding public on-demand song tutorials, digital PDFs, and streaming tiers)
- Dedicated Guest Hub Screen: Manage song tutorials (e.g. yuyuyuyuyu, Jehovah Is Your Name), Cloudflare R2 video/PDF uploads, micro-tuition pricing (10 KES / 1 hr), digital store e-books (Music Theory for 1 KES), and streaming pass tiers
- Live Guest Entries & Pass Roster: Real-time table auditing all guest admissions, M-Pesa receipt codes, phone numbers, active/expired statuses, remaining time countdowns, with quick actions to extend (+60m), revoke, or grant manual passes
